headline: Melexis posts a Claude-based AMS verification internship for automotive sensor ICs
fact: Melexis posted Bevaix internship/master's-thesis project 3932 for automotive sensor IC mixed-signal design verification and system integration. The six-month 2027 project assigns Claude Code workflows, test-case development, and automated classification and root-cause analysis of simulation/verification failures. SystemVerilog/Verilog is essential; UVM is beneficial. Optional work compares Chipstack with Claude. Deployment into real projects and efficiency improvements are expected project results, not demonstrated outcomes. The retained official timestamp is October 5 at 20:00 UTC; 2027 identifies the work cohort.

sources.title: Melexis Careers: AI Infrastructure Development for Automotive Sensor IC Design Verification (3932)
sources.summary: Previously verified official JobPosting metadata gives October 5, 2026 at 20:00 UTC and identifier 3932; the UTC date corrects the prior October 6 JST record. The official page returns HTTP 403 on October 25, so this is an availability check, not a fresh full-text review. Retained duties concern Claude-based mixed-signal test development and failure triage.
